Get discovered. Build momentum.

When people ask AI who to call or what to buy, it gives them a short list. Most organizations have no idea if they’re on it. If you’re not, you may be invisible in that answer — no matter how good your website, products or services might be.

The AI Visibility Framework

Get FOUND

Five stages to get discovered, trusted and recommended by AI.

  1. F
    FindableCan AI actually read your site?
  2. O
    OriginalAre you saying anything AI can’t get somewhere else?
  3. U
    UnderstoodIs your information consistent across all listings?
  4. N
    NamedDoes AI recommend you?
  5. D
    DrivenIs any of it turning into conversions?

The order matters. Organizations can pour money into content when AI can’t even crawl their site. Fix Findable first, then build toward the next stage.

From visibility to sustained growth

Mimi’s Momentum Machine

Get FOUND powers the Attract stage of Mimi’s Momentum Machine. The Momentum Machine connects Attract, Engage, Convert and Advocate into a continuous cycle, turning discovery into ongoing relationships and renewed momentum.

These two frameworks work together: Get FOUND focuses on AI visibility, while the Momentum Machine connects that visibility to the broader growth journey.

FOUND gets you discovered.
The Momentum Machine keeps them coming back.

About your strategist

Meet Mimi Damm.

A marketing advocate building digital ecosystems for a changing world.

Mimi Damm is a marketing advocate, building digital ecosystems to serve healthcare organizations, SMBs, and corporate enterprises with the specialized, AI-first strategy they need to grow.

She works extensively with Federally Qualified Health Centers and community health systems, helping them navigate HIPAA-compliant digital marketing, CTV and programmatic advertising, and the search landscape as it is reshaped by AI.

Her client work spans hospital systems and local businesses alike, including a statewide Connected TV awareness campaign for a major health system in Vermont and a nationwide digital strategy for an automotive conglomerate. Across these engagements, Mimi has built a reputation for translating complex, fast-moving technology—from pixel-free retargeting to AI Overviews—into clear, actionable strategy for organizations that do not have the luxury of getting it wrong.

Recently, she built a curriculum around digital workforce recruitment for Adept New England, centered on recruitment of behavioral health clinicians.

Beyond client work, Mimi holds board-level involvement with community health organizations across Vermont and New Hampshire and is a sought-after speaker on healthcare marketing and digital strategy.
